integrity: Proof includes explicit induction, separate absence lower bound, digit-gap calculation; finite independent code checks supplement but do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Binary finite words with specified boundary gaps and alternating internal gap lower bounds.
Cantor specialization only for complete substitution levels at least two.
No classification of longer absent subsequences, all minimal absent subsequences, or embedding counts.
Historical priority remains conditional upon available primary literature and database records.
title: Nine rigid shortest absent subsequences in Cantor words and a gap-inflation family
